values: AxomRank Reel Sequence and Funnel Mix
90 ideas and written scripts • three chapters • English narration drafts • no publication dates assigned
Evaluate teaching through methods, explanations and review
Start a real product task, inspect access or make a relevant enquiry
Use the Order column as a sequence, not an obligation to publish daily. Each 10-Reel block contains 5 TOFU, 3 MOFU and 2 BOFU.
All storyboards total 30 seconds. Voiceovers contain 59–70 words, targeting 118–140 words per minute over the full Reel. Rehearse once; let visuals fill remaining time.
The hook stays at 0–3 seconds and the CTA at 26–30 seconds. Middle beat durations vary with script length. Time labels appear in each shot cell.
The alternate verbal hook is a replacement for the first line, not an extra line. The timed script uses the primary hook. Rehearse again after substituting.
Single-question beats allow a brief reveal hold. Multi-question Reels explicitly ask viewers to pause the Reel to attempt the set.
Scripts are in English. For Assamese delivery, translate the whole narration and screen text, preserve the working, and have a fluent reader check the wording and final typography.
Use 9:16 framing, maroon #80151A, charcoal #292929 and ivory #F7F2EC. Keep important text clear of Instagram interface overlays. Start on the hook action, then use a small Rang Ghar mark.
Keep speech clear. Desk sounds, paper flips, timer taps or tea-cup sounds can support the opening action. Use a quiet licensed music bed if needed; no specific trending track is assumed.
BOFU scripts specify real routes and current access details. Amber prerequisite cells mark named tools or language/PYQ routes that require a live-feature check before filming.
Maths and reasoning questions are original practice. GK source IDs are listed below. Do not add exam-cycle rules, selection claims, fabricated results, prices or scarcity.
Creator scenes are demonstrations. Obtain consent before using identifiable student submissions or results. The screenplay does not claim that suggested interactions have already happened.
Keep the 45/27/18 allocation by replacing an unavailable BOFU tool demo with an actual practice-start or support-enquiry Reel. A manual teaching tutorial with a save CTA belongs in MOFU.
